snippet.title: Fast Draw Showdown (Wii) - Longplay
snippet.description: The most frustrating FMV game I ever played! The lag from the wiimote makes this game impossible. Fortunately, I'm the FMV God so I soldiered on and eventually beat this shit so I could say I did it. All hail me lmao
